{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The American people deserve access to timely and accurate data on activities supported by their tax dollars, including policing.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We will collect and publish data on the use of force in police departments across the country to promote transparency and accountability.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We will establish a national registry of officers who have been found to have abused their power.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support measures to increase diversity among the ranks of police departments, so law enforcement agencies look more like the communities they serve.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We will seek increased funding for officer health and well-being in police departments across the country, including for personal safety equipment and mental health services.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Substance use disorders are diseases, not crimes.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe no one should be in prison solely because they use drugs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will decriminalize marijuana use and reschedule it through executive action on the federal level.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support legalization of medical marijuana.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe states should be able to make their own decisions about recreational marijuana use.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Justice Department should not launch federal prosecutions of conduct that is legal at the state level.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"All past criminal convictions for cannabis use should be automatically expunged.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support increased use of drug courts, harm reduction interventions, and treatment diversion programs for those struggling with substance use disorders.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
